    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    EdgesBuilder.NodeGroupChain
    EdgesBuilder.from(Node first, Node second, Node... rest)
    Starts a chain at first, second and each node in rest so they can join without a fan-out: g.from(a, b).joinTo(join).
    EdgesBuilder.NodeGroupChain
    EdgesBuilder.from(Collection<? extends Node> nodes)
    Starts a chain at nodes (such as a computed list) so they can join without a fan-out, like EdgesBuilder.from(Node, Node, Node...).
    EdgesBuilder.NodeGroupChain
    EdgesBuilder.EdgeChain.then(Node first, Node second, Node... rest)
    Fans out by connecting the current node to first, second and each node in rest, like EdgesBuilder.EdgeChain.then(Collection): g.from(a).then(b, c).joinTo(join).
    EdgesBuilder.NodeGroupChain
    EdgesBuilder.EdgeChain.then(Collection<? extends Node> targets)
    Fans out by connecting the current node to each of targets (such as a computed list) so they run concurrently, and continues from them as a group that EdgesBuilder.NodeGroupChain.joinTo(JoinNode) can join.
